DECLARATION OF THE RIGHTS OF THE ASSOCIATED WORKERS

We, the undersigned, declare that the present order is intolerable and
that its continuation is a crime against those who labour.

Article I. — Every member of this association shall hold the common
interest above their own.

Article II. — We demand the abolition of the privileges of birth and the
immediate recognition of the right to work.

Article III. — It is the duty of every citizen to resist an order founded
upon hunger.

Article IV. — Our enemies are those who profit from that order and who
call its maintenance peace.

We reject the compromise offered to us. We repudiate the counsel of
patience. A new era begins on the day this declaration is signed, and it
begins by our own act and not by permission.

Down with the rule of the counting-house. Long live the association of
free workers.

To arms, citizens, in the sense that the word must now bear: to the
arms of organisation, of the common fund, of the refusal to labour on
the terms offered.

We proclaim these principles and we call upon every worker to join us
and to carry them into effect without delay.
